## Appearance

Mary Joe is a young French girl. She has a buxom build and a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

Mary Joe is a young woman who had never seen anyone with croup. When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell ill with severe croup while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) were away, Mary Joe was present at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated the sick child through the night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_
